note: PAREN AS A STRING, the value nobody expects: Emacs takes the string as the literal GROUP OPENER and closes it itself. Emacs answers (0 "ab") for "\\(?2:", i.e. the caller chose the group NUMBER -- the escape hatch from the numbering shift PAREN `t' causes. Measured because a `stringp' branch is easy to leave out and this is a documented value. kg answers `wrong-number-of-arguments' at this pin.
